messages:
kevin: Quick follow-up from today's partial responses incident. We need clear owners and short deadlines for runtime, SDK, and proxy mitigations.
anya: Looks like the proxy sent FIN mid-stream during backend slowdowns; ~1.6% of streams affected. Also saw clients reconnect without validating last-chunk.
sam: I'll own SDK changes: add a reconnect sequence check + small reassembly buffer. Plan: PR in 48h, tests in 96h. Ticket RINF-4340.
nina: Runtime change: enforce atomic flush + emit application EOM frame. I'll gate behind feature-flag and add integration test for FIN mid-stream. PR by tomorrow EOD. Ticket RINF-4341.
raj: Infra/proxy: increase idle keepalive for streaming routes to 75s and enable keepalive pings. Will deploy to infra-canary tonight and monitor 12h. Ticket RINF-4342.
kevin: Observability?
anya: I'll add metric stream.finalization_missing and alert at 0.5% over 10m. Dashboards in Console. ETA: 6h.
sre-oncall: I'll add the alert to oncall runbook and link rollback steps for proxy. Pager if >1% for 15m.
ci-bot: Created tasks RINF-4340, RINF-4341, RINF-4342 and attached to incident-1779955555.kanban.
kevin: Timelines summary: SDK PR 48h, runtime PR EOD tomorrow, proxy canary tonight -> full in 48h if green, metrics today. Weekly followups until stable.
sam: SDK will remain backward-compatible; strict validation toggled by server advert.
nina: Integration test added to repo/stream-tests and CI nightly run.
raj: Canary deploy started at 1779955650 on infra-canary. Monitoring dashboards linked.
kevin: I'll update the incident doc with owners and schedule a 7-day review. If alerts fire before then, we escalate immediately. Closing when PR links are posted here. :thumbsup:
